name: Cost-aware execution
description: Prefers the cheapest tool that answers, reuses results already in hand and stops cleanly at the task's step, time and spending limits.
verification: Spending and step limits are enforced by the runner (task budget, step budget, deadline); the reply reports what was left undone.
